doc: I56's game sidecar for target M3 (key I56, definitions G-C1..G-C3, G-R1..G-R3, N3 and O35). Fixed at I56's prereg, before any game record. The trusted flags are a preregistered judgment, one per class with its reason; the documents and the run member's initial state are pinned by sha256. The value-flow document's sha256 (V8) is pinned later, by spec/M5/lib/games_M3_flows.json, in a build commit that precedes every game record.
member_caller_why: each predicate compares the caller with another member contract's address (the queue's MESSENGER immutable, L1Staking's and Submitter's rollupContract): the caller is code of the deployment, reached only through a member call, not a principal

premises.P-bond: every atom of the bond family debited in the law's run is positive: the bonded address's stake at risk is non-zero (an active submitter's stake is at least the minimum stake, which is positive)
premises.P-gas: transaction gas is outside the value flows (definitions.L6.ordinal_payoff)

run.why: the witnesses of M3's REFUTED records run on the Rollup's extracted model from the deployment state that the M3 model's Reach starts from

trust_rule: a class is trusted iff it is a member's onlyOwner group; every other class (anyone, a submitter, a challenger, a whitelisted staker) is untrusted
